{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check premises
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Arm values:", df['arm'].unique())
print("Responded values:", df['responded'].unique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch
print("Assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())"}
